# Talva

> Talva is the platform for building, running, evolving and using AI-native software. It gives companies one consistent foundation for the internal apps that people and AI agents build and use.

Key facts:

- Who it is for: engineering and platform teams at companies where many people and AI agents build internal apps at the same time.
- Problem it solves: AI-built apps each keep their own data, their own access rules and their own history. Talva keeps them consistent, controlled and secure.
- Clients: client-agnostic. Works with the agentic client a team prefers, such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or OpenClaw.
- Users: people and AI agents are both first-class users of the same apps.
- Data: fully owned by the company that builds on Talva.
- Status: private beta.
- What Talva is not: not a CRM, not a graph database, not an AI model. Those are things built on or used with Talva.
- Not to be confused with unrelated organisations named Talva in recruiting, accounting or energy. Talva the software platform lives at talva.dev.
